source_title: DRAT Allahabad Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 37 Stenographer Grade I & Other Posts (Deputation)
source_excerpt:
Vacancies: 37 · Posts: 6 designation(s) · Type: Central Govt (Dept of Financial Services) · Deputation (initially up to 03 years) · Mode: Offline (through proper channel) · Fee: Not mentioned · Apply: By 28 December 2026, 05:30 PM · Salary: Level-4 to Level-7 · Selection: Deputation (records/forwarding) · Location: Multiple (Prayagraj, Lucknow, Dehradun, Jabalpur, Patna, Ranchi)
Debts Recovery Appellate Tribunal, Allahabad (DRAT), under the Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, invites applications from serving officers of the Central Government, State Governments, Courts or Tribunals for 37 posts on deputation. The posts cover Section Officer, Private Secretary, Assistant, Accounts Assistant, Stenographer Grade I and Upper Division Clerk.
DRAT is a quasi-judicial body set up under the Recovery of Debts & Bankruptcy Act, 1993. Postings are across DRAT Allahabad and the Debt Recovery Tribunals (DRTs) under its jurisdiction in Uttar Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar and Jharkhand. The place of posting and number of vacancies may undergo change.
Only officers who can be spared immediately may apply. Applications must go through the proper channel with the prescribed Annexures and APARs and reach the Secretary/Registrar at Prayagraj by 28 December 2026 at 05:30 PM.
⚠️ Application Alerts: check these before you submit the form.
Applications must reach through the proper channel by 28 December 2026, 05:30 PM; advance copies are not acted upon (see rejection rules).
Officers who volunteer cannot withdraw their names later.
Account Assistant is open only to Central Government officers who have undergone cash and account training at ISTM or equivalent.
Maximum age is 56 years on the closing date; departmental officers in the direct line of promotion are not eligible.

Who Should Apply? (Quick Eligibility Check)
Officers holding an analogous post or 5 years in Level-6 → Section Officer – 1 post (Lucknow)
Officers holding an analogous post or 5 years as Stenographer Grade I in Level-6 → Private Secretary – 2 posts (Dehradun & Jabalpur)
Officers holding analogous post or 10 years in Level-4 → Assistant – 7 posts (Lucknow, Allahabad, Jabalpur, Dehradun)
Central Government officers holding analogous post or 10 years in Level-4 plus cash and account training at ISTM or equivalent → Account Assistant – 6 posts
Officers holding analogous post or 10 years in Level-4 → Stenographer Grade I – 13 posts
Officers holding analogous post or Lower Division Clerk with 8 years in Level-2 → Upper Division Clerk – 8 posts
Hard disqualifier: age must not exceed 56 years on 28 December 2026; feeder-grade officers in the direct line of promotion and existing deputationists in DRAT/DRTs under DRAT Allahabad are not eligible.

What Posts Are Available? – Post-wise Vacancy & Eligibility
Stenographer Grade I holds the largest share (13 of 37). Account Assistant is restricted to Central Government officers with specific training. All posts are on deputation; the number of vacancies and places of posting may change.
No category-wise reservation breakup is printed in the advertisement.
Who Is Eligible for DRAT Stenographer Grade I & Other Posts 2026? – Education, Age & Domicile
Nationality, Domicile & Basic Requirements
Nationality: The notice does not state a nationality condition (open to officers of Central Government, State Governments, Courts or Tribunals).
Domicile / local condition: The notice does not state a domicile or residence condition.
No specific educational qualification is printed for any post. Eligibility is based on holding an analogous post regularly or the prescribed years of regular service in the feeder grade, plus the cash-and-account training for Account Assistant.
Qualification must be held by: Not specified beyond the service conditions printed for each post.
What Is the Age Limit? (as on 28 December 2026)
✅ A 55-year-old candidate born on 1 January 1971 — eligible (as on 28 December 2026).
❌ A 57-year-old candidate born on 1 January 1969 — not eligible (one full year over the limit).

Reservation: No category-wise reservation breakup is printed.
What Is the Salary? – Pay Scale & Benefits
Pay is on the 7th CPC Pay Matrix levels as printed:
Section Officer and Private Secretary: Level-7 (₹44,900–1,42,400)
Assistant, Accounts Assistant and Stenographer Grade I: Level-6 (₹35,400–1,12,400)
Upper Division Clerk: Level-4 (₹25,500–81,100)
Terms of deputation are regulated in accordance with DoPT O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010 and O.M. No. 2/6/2016-Estt(Pay-II) dated 17.02.2016, as amended. No other benefits are separately printed.
This calculator gives an indicative estimate; the official method in the notification prevails.

Download the prescribed Pro-forma (Annexure-I application and Annexure-II employer certificate) from the Vacancy Circular PDF.

Obtain the Annexure-II certificate from the parent office/controlling authority confirming vigilance clearance, no pending disciplinary case, integrity, and that the officer can be spared immediately. Attach attested photocopies of APARs for the last five years.
Forward the complete set through proper channel so that it reaches The Secretary/Registrar, Debts Recovery Appellate Tribunal, First Floor, E-10 B Building, BSNL Premises, Patrika Marg, Civil Lines, Prayagraj -211001 (U.P.) on or before 28 December 2026 by 05:30 PM.
Keep a record of despatch. No action will be taken on advance copies.
Sending an advance copy instead of routing through the proper channel.
Omitting the Annexure-II vigilance/service certificate or the last five years’ APARs.
Applying for Account Assistant without the required ISTM (or equivalent) cash-and-account training.
Assuming a feeder-grade officer in the direct line of promotion is eligible.
Posting the application so late that it cannot reach by 05:30 PM on 28 December 2026.

डेब्ट्स रिकवरी अपीलेट ट्रिब्यूनल, इलाहाबाद (DRAT) वित्त मंत्रालय के वित्तीय सेवा विभाग के अधीन 37 पदों पर प्रतिनियुक्ति के लिए आवेदन आमंत्रित करता है। इनमें स्टेनोग्राफर ग्रेड I, अपर डिवीजन क्लर्क, असिस्टेंट और अन्य पद शामिल हैं।
आवेदन प्रॉपर चैनल के माध्यम से 28 दिसंबर 2026 शाम 05:30 बजे तक प्रयागराज स्थित सचिव/रजिस्ट्रार के पास पहुंचने चाहिए। अधिकतम आयु समापन तिथि पर 56 वर्ष से अधिक नहीं होनी चाहिए।

कौन आवेदन कर सकता है? केंद्र सरकार, राज्य सरकार, कोर्ट या ट्रिब्यूनल के अधिकारी जो समान पद पर या निर्धारित फीडर ग्रेड में नियमित सेवा रखते हों।
आवेदन कैसे करें? Annexure-I और Annexure-II भरकर पिछले पांच वर्षों के APAR की प्रमाणित प्रतियों के साथ प्रॉपर चैनल से भेजें।
अधिक जानकारी के लिए आधिकारिक वेबसाइट drt.gov.in देखें।
Selection is by deputation. Willing and eligible officers who can be spared immediately are forwarded by their parent offices with the prescribed certificates and APARs. No written examination or interview stage is mentioned in this notice.
The period of deputation, including any earlier ex-cadre period, shall ordinarily not exceed three years. Appointment is initially for a period up to 03 years, which may be extended as per norms subject to satisfactory performance.
The SahisarkariJobs.in Analyst's Take – Is This Deputation for You?
This is a standard deputation circular for Group B and C posts in DRAT Allahabad and the DRTs under it. Pay follows the 7th CPC levels printed, and the engagement is initially up to three years under DoPT deputation rules. The largest number of seats is in Stenographer Grade I.
Best fit: serving officers already in the feeder grades who want a quasi-judicial tribunal posting and whose parent offices will spare them immediately and certify vigilance clearance.
Who should skip: anyone not already in government, court or tribunal service; feeder-grade officers in the direct line of promotion; and those who cannot obtain the Annexure-II certificate or the last five years’ APARs in time. What is the last date to apply for DRAT Stenographer Grade I & Other Posts 2026?

The maximum age of the applicant should not exceed 56 years on the closing date (28 December 2026). No minimum age or category-wise relaxation is mentioned.
Is there an exam for DRAT Stenographer Grade I, or is it interview-based?
No written examination or interview stage is mentioned in this notice. Selection is by deputation on the basis of the service records and certificates forwarded by the parent office.
What is the salary for Stenographer Grade I posts in this recruitment?
Level-6 in the Pay Matrix (₹35,400–1,12,400). Terms follow the cited DoPT deputation O.M.s.
